**DK25.4** is a medical diagnosis code within the ICD-10-DK classification system that designates a chronic or unspecified gastric ulcer accompanied by bleeding [^src1]. In the context of the Danish healthcare system, this code plays a critical role in clinical quality assurance, specifically for monitoring the safety of treatments prescribed to patients with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src1] [^src3].

The code is formally utilized in the national clinical quality indicators to track the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) among the atrial fibrillation patient population [^src3]. Because atrial fibrillation patients are frequently prescribed anticoagulant medications, tracking bleeding complications is a vital metric for evaluating treatment safety and clinical outcomes [^src2] [^src3]. DK25.4 is grouped within a broader framework of gastrointestinal bleeding codes—ranging from [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] to [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]] and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] to [[dk92-2|DK92.2]]—which together help capture the full spectrum of digestive tract hemorrhages [^src1]. 

Documentation of DK25.4 appears consistently across successive annual reports for the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute. The code's definition and application are explicitly detailed in the methodology sections of the 2023, 2024, and 2025 reports, underscoring its ongoing relevance in standardized national data collection and regional healthcare comparisons [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

## Claims
- **Diagnostic:** For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
